            pa brjod pa 2 te dngos su bshad pa brgyad dang | don gyis go mnyan thos kyi rtsa ba'i
            nyes pa na ste bcu 2 <abbr>yin no</abbr> zhes <abbr>zer ro</abbr> ||</seg></TEI>
